correctness.rationale: The exact prescribed four three-state update matrices give the exchangeable covariance recurrence T(q). Symbolically verified determinant and scalar resolvent produce a cubic Schur polynomial and the rational first-coordinate generating function. All cubic Schur factors are positive for 0≤q<1/10, proving geometric mean-square contraction of all state coordinates. At q=1/10, the unique unit pole has coefficient 6/19 and remaining poles have absolute value sqrt(20)>1. For q>1/10 a noncancelled pole lies strictly between zero and one, implying limsup E[x_k²]^(1/k)>1. The embedded exact symbolic checker proves algebraic identities and performs 35 independent rational finite histories; finite enumeration is not the source of infinite-horizon assertions.

value.rationale: The two-worker half-dropout DIANA model is a minimal natural test of compressed gradient-memory optimization. Fixing worker objectives, marginal success probabilities, expected communication, and algorithm parameters while changing only the coupling q yields three qualitatively distinct mean-square regimes and an explicit critical positive floor. This materially complements independent-compressor DIANA and general small-step theory, supplying a sharp correlation design boundary, not a routine parameter rescaling or a known-table recomputation.
